text:
Sara (Support): QuillCare filed a ticket asking for streaming completions that emit incremental function-call events to their webhook and a final validated JSON object. They want downstream to start processing on partials.

Lana (Sales): They expect bursts ~350 qps, steady 35 rps, target <250ms per chunk. If we can provide a beta SLA they may sign an enterprise deal.

Alex (Product): Need clarity: webhook vs websocket? resumable tokens? schema validation server-side?

Sara (Support): Webhook preferred (HTTP POST events). They want resumable resume_token support and a final "finalized" event. Server-side schema validation required.

Devon (Eng): Current system streams tokens + final fncall only. To support partial fncall events we need event framing (fncall.start/update/finish), resume tokens, and idempotency. Rough estimates: 2w spec + 3-5w build + 1w docs + canary. Major risks: replay duplication, backpressure, and compatibility.

Mike (SRE): Webhook delivery must include retries, backoff, idempotency keys, and DLQ. We also need per-request tracing for billing.

Alex (Product): Proposed beta acceptance criteria:
- deterministic fncall event types sent to webhook (start/update/finish)
- resume token and idempotent replay
- final validated JSON event with explicit error codes
- Python/TS SDK helpers for reconnect/replay
- webhook signing + optional PII redaction hook

Lana (Sales): Customer asked for 6	6 weeks. Can we do webhook-only beta in 6?

Devon (Eng): Webhook-only beta possible in 6 weeks if we limit to a single model family and no on-prem. Full rollout 10-12 weeks. PII redaction hook +3-5 days.

ops-bot: Created ticket INF-4830 and assigned to Devon.

Alex (Product): I'll write acceptance criteria and mark P0. Devon to draft RFC.

Sara (Support): I'll confirm with QuillCare about being the canary and the redaction requirement.

Devon (Eng): Sample event idea:
POST /webhook/quillcare
Headers: {"X-Redwood-Event":"fncall.update","X-Req":"rq_001"}
Body: {"request_id":"rq_001","call_id":"callA","event":"fncall.update","delta":{"op":"append","path":"items[2]","value":{}},"resume_token":"r_tok_1"}
